use: Full-bleed hero background behind a large Korean headline. The left third is covered by a dark scrim, so the composition must survive being half-obscured.
goldStandard: EPFL AI Center — one calm declarative frame, architectural rather than sci-fi, restraint over spectacle.
criteria: Reads as real architectural photography, not a 3D render or concept art
Has a genuine light source and believable falloff; no uniform ambient glow
Deep enough on the left half that white text will sit on it at AA contrast
Cyan appears as accent lighting only, never as an overall colour wash
Contains no people, no readable signage, no UI, no lens dirt overlays
prompt: Ultra wide architectural photograph of a vast empty modern university library hall at dusk. Dark polished concrete floor, tall glass curtain wall, thin horizontal LED light lines receding into deep one-point perspective, soft blue evening light outside. A faint geometric wireframe of connected dots glows softly in the air, blurred. Anamorphic lens, gentle atmospheric haze, shallow depth of field, subtle film grain, muted deep navy graphite palette with a cool cyan accent. Empty of people. No text, no letters, no signage, no logos, no watermark.

use: Portrait card image for the smart-factory research domain, seen at roughly 420x520 with a gradient over its lower third.
goldStandard: MIT Schwarzman College of Computing — evidence of real facilities, not decoration.
criteria: The subject is legible at card size, not a wash of abstract light
Reads specifically as manufacturing, not as generic technology
Lower third stays simple enough for a gradient and title to sit over it
Palette matches the site: navy and graphite with a single cyan accent
No people, no text, no logos
prompt: Abstract smart-factory visualization: a robotic arm silhouette in a dark automated plant, cyan laser scan lines sweeping across a conveyor, sparse glowing sensor nodes connected by thin lines. Cinematic still, anamorphic lens, volumetric haze, shallow depth of field, fine film grain, deep navy graphite palette with cool cyan-teal accent light. No text, no letters, no logos, no watermark.
